classes.name: RepostspaceClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS re:Post Private service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: batchAddRole
methods.description: Adds a role in batch to the service.

methods.description: Removes a role in batch from the service.

methods.name: deregisterAdmin
methods.description: Deregisters an admin from the service.

methods.name: getSpace
